meta.layout: Coefficient matrices are k x n (rows: const, then lag 1 block in variable order, ..., lag p block; columns: equations), y_t = B'x_t + u_t. Matrices are row-major nested lists.

description: (a) log p(Y | h) at fixed hyperparameters, alpha = 2, var_const = 1e7, explicit psi. log_ml/log_ml_full/log_ml_dummy: exact QR-based values, log_ml = log_ml_full - log_ml_dummy (data + dummies minus dummies only). *_bvar: BVAR 1.0.5 (BVAR:::bv_ml). BVAR's dummy-only term plugs in the prior mean b instead of the dummy posterior mean, which is exact only when Y_d = X_d b (random-walk prior mean): bvar_is_exact flags this. log_posterior_bvar = log_ml_bvar + sum(log_hyperprior) (Gamma densities, natural scale).

definitions.bvar_auto_sd: BVAR's psi = 'auto': sqrt(sigma2) of stats::arima(y_j, order = c(p, 0, 0)) (method 'CSS-ML', with mean) fitted to rows p+1..T of the raw data (the trimmed Y); a STANDARD DEVIATION that BVAR nevertheless uses as the IW scale diagonal and in Omega.
definitions.arima_ml_variance: sigma2 of the same arima fit (= bvar_auto_sd^2), variance units.
definitions.ols_ar_variance_dof: OLS AR(p) with constant on the full raw series (T - p equations, p + 1 regressors): SSR / (T - p - (p + 1)).
definitions.ols_ar_variance_mle: Same OLS AR(p) fit: SSR / (T - p).
